papers.title: Reading Why: Born-Measured Attention with Exact Word Evidence on Light and Qubits
findings: Section2.1 Eq2 is row-normalized squared complex overlap attention. It points to CNet2610.08592 as a prior source; that cited original is pending, not independently read.

Its q=Qh and k=Kh are linear fields, not explicitly unit-normalized pure states in Eq2; nonzero query norm cancels by row while key norms remain a token-dependent factor. Native states are unit norm and add epsilon. Algebraic pattern overlaps, full functions are not identical.

Section2.2 Eq5 defines held-denominator polynomial F_g and its IG from zero; stated degree bound200 yields100GaussLegendre nodes. The author explicitly distinguishes exact completeness from evidence ranking/utility and from the free-denominator deletion function.
AppendixB p34 explains that the free-denominator path has a different zero-limit because a reference slot does not shrink; freezing changes the attribution object and baseline.
Introduction acknowledges classical polynomial models can have the same exact completeness property.
limits: Selected original text/page images only. Fig2 p6 text read but visual diagram not rendered. No code, full formal degree proof, hardware/optics/resource analysis, eSNLI results or numerical attribution/deletion reproduction.
Reported eSNLI accuracy/evidence numbers are source claims, not verified project facts or comparable to ReTACRED Macro.
The source is a preprint updated12Nov2026; no priority or peer-review conclusion. CNet and its cited attribution-design predecessors need exact-original followup.
No direct finite-polynomial attribution transfer through Q-RMEA tanh/RY/RZ and final softmax.

papers.title: Positive semidefinite rank
findings: Section2.2/Eq6 explicitly gives Hermitian-to-real PSD isometry and factor-two dimension bound.
Theorem2.9(ii) and p7 proof absorb strictly positive diagonal row/column scaling into PSD factors; (v) is a known squared-inner-product PSD factorization.
limits: The paper develops original results and surveys known properties; these particular tools are not new here.
Only selected pages read. Theorem2.10 proof continues beyond selected p7, and p9 Lemma2.13 proof is deferred to unread Section6. No complete PSD-rank or computational-complexity survey/proof audit.
General PSD factorizations do not certify a rank-one trace-normalized two-layer PQC/affine prepare function family or task advantage.

papers.title: Matrices with high completely positive semidefinite rank
findings: Section2 p4 again explicitly describes standard complex-to-real PSD isometry and dimension doubling.
The subject is square symmetric Gram factorizations by a single family, unlike a general rectangular class/token cross table.
limits: Only pp1,4 read. No exponential lower-bound/Clifford/Hadamard construction or full main theorem proof inspected; no transfer of those results to Q-RMEA.
Internal title-page date17Oct2016 differs from arXiv watermark26Oct2016; both retained.
